prompt: Asset type: one original photorealistic blank ivory dice cube for a Japanese mahjong game sprite. A SINGLE real small polished ivory-white resin gaming die, blank with absolutely NO pips on any face, isolated on genuinely transparent background. Orthographic camera looking down at about 40 degrees, perfectly straight-on to the front so only TWO faces are visible: the rectangular foreshortened top face and the front face below it. NO left or right face visible, no sideways rotation, straight vertical left/right outline. Overall silhouette close to square with vertical total slightly greater than width, approximately width 20 to height 22. The upper top face should occupy about 14 of the 22 units of total height; the front face occupies remaining 8. Convincing physical cube volume, gently rounded corners and edges, subtle ivory resin translucency, smooth polished highlights, fine molding realism, recessed seam of shading at the transition between top and front. Soft studio light from upper left, top face lighter, front face naturally shaded soft grey ivory, soft contact shadow immediately below and to the right. Premium tabletop-game product-photography quality, not pixel art, not a flat icon, not a cartoon, not a rounded app button. No table or floor, transparent background. Full cube fully visible with generous transparent padding. No symbols, no text, no logos, no watermark, no decorative frame. Do not copy any existing game graphics.
